title: Honeymoon Trail of Phuket, Krabi and Koh Samui
alt: A white Buddha statue on a hilltop above the Phuket coast at sunset
transport: Private and shared transfers with speedboat and ferry crossings

expert.name: Ananya Iyer
expert.quote: Eight days and three beaches, with the Big Buddha tour on day two so you get your bearings early.
expert.tip: The Krabi to Samui day is long, so take the early ferry and nap on the crossing. On Samui, ask the hotel to book a driver for the ring road rather than renting a scooter.

summary: Eight days across three Thai coasts. A Phuket city tour with the Big Buddha, two nights under the Ao Nang cliffs with the Krabi 4 Islands tour, two slow days on Koh Samui and a final Phuket night before you fly home.
included: Included: 7 nights in 3 hotels with daily breakfast; Phuket city tour with the Big Buddha; Krabi 4 Islands speedboat tour with a lunch box; 14 airport, intercity and island transfers including the Samui ferry crossings both ways; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; temple and park entry fees; lunches and dinners other than the island tour lunch box; personal expenses.

day_titles.2: Phuket sightseeing with the Big Buddha

1: Arrival at Phuket International Airport and private sedan transfer to Patong
Check in at Club Bamboo and keep the first evening free
Optional: Patong beach, quieter Kata beach or a walk down Bangla Road
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the Phuket city tour
Wat Chalong, the Big Buddha on Nakkerd hill and Old Phuket Town
Karon viewpoint over the three bays before the ride back
Evening free along the beach road
3: Check out and private sedan transfer by road to Krabi
Check in at Timber House in Ao Nang, under the limestone cliffs
Afternoon and evening free on the beach road
Optional: the weekend night market or an elephant sanctuary inland
4: Breakfast, then shared transfer to the Ao Nang pier
Speedboat transfer out to Koh Poda, Tup island and Chicken island
Snorkel the shallows and stop at Phra Nang beach, lunch box on board
Return shared transfer to your hotel in the afternoon
5: Breakfast, check out and shared transfer to the ferry terminal
Ferry transfer across to Koh Samui, then on to Chaweng
Check in at Montien House among the palms behind the beach
Optional: the Big Buddha temple at Wat Phra Yai or Wat Plai Laem
6: Breakfast, then a full day with nothing booked
Chaweng beach is a short walk away, with loungers and shade
Optional: Ang Thong marine park by boat or Wat Khunaram inland
Optional: the Hin Ta and Hin Yai rocks on the south coast
7: Breakfast, check out and shared transfer to the Samui pier
Ferry transfer back across to Phuket and on to Patong
Check in for the final night and take the afternoon slowly
Optional: Muay Thai at Patong stadium or the Phuket FantaSea show
8: Breakfast and an unhurried check out
Private sedan transfer to Phuket International Airport

stops.name: Phuket
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Club Bamboo in Patong, a short walk from the beach

program.name: Patong and the Big Buddha
program.description: Two nights in Patong with a city tour that takes in Wat Chalong, the Big Buddha and the old shophouse streets.

activities.name: Phuket City Tour with the Big Buddha
activities.description: A shared tour through Wat Chalong, the white Buddha on Nakkerd hill, Old Phuket Town and Karon viewpoint.

activities.name: Kata Beach
activities.description: A quieter curve of sand south of Patong, good for swimming and a short ride from the hotel.

activities.name: Bangla Road After Dark
activities.description: Patong's night strip, closed to traffic after dark and lined with bars, street food and live music.

stops.name: Krabi
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Timber House in Ao Nang, close to the beach road

program.name: Cliffs and the 4 Islands
program.description: Two nights in Ao Nang with a speedboat tour of Koh Poda, Tup island, Chicken island and Phra Nang beach.

activities.name: Krabi 4 Islands by Speedboat
activities.description: A speedboat day across Koh Poda, Tup island and Chicken island, with snorkelling, Phra Nang beach and a lunch box on board.

activities.name: Krabi Weekend Night Market
activities.description: Krabi town's Friday to Sunday market, with grilled seafood, curries and sweets sold from stalls along the river.

activities.name: Krabi Elephant Sanctuary
activities.description: A no riding sanctuary inland from Ao Nang where you feed and walk with rescued elephants alongside their keepers.

stops.name: Koh Samui
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Montien House among palms behind Chaweng beach

program.name: Two slow days on Samui
program.description: Nothing booked on the island, with Chaweng beach on the doorstep and temples and viewpoints on the ring road.

activities.name: Big Buddha Temple
activities.description: Wat Phra Yai on its small island, reached by causeway, with a golden seated Buddha looking out over the sea.

activities.name: Wat Plai Laem
activities.description: An eighteen armed Guanyin statue rising out of a lake, with carved halls and fish that come up to be fed.

activities.name: Ang Thong Marine Park
activities.description: A boat day out to forty two islands with a hidden lagoon, snorkelling stops and a viewpoint climb on Koh Wua Talap.

activities.name: Hin Ta and Hin Yai Rocks
activities.description: The grandfather and grandmother rocks on the south coast, a short stop with a boardwalk down to the sea.

stops.name: Phuket
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Back at Club Bamboo in Patong for the final night

program.name: A last Phuket night
program.description: Back across from Samui for one more evening in Patong, with the stadium and the big shows close by.

activities.name: Muay Thai at Patong Stadium
activities.description: Live Muay Thai bouts most evenings at the Patong stadium, loud, quick and over by about ten.

activities.name: Phuket FantaSea Show
activities.description: A large stage show on Thai myth with elephants, acrobatics and a buffet hall, out at Kamala beach.

activities.name: Freedom Beach
activities.description: A small bay south of Patong reached by longtail boat, with the clearest water on this stretch of coast.
